entities.name: 2-cyclohexylamino-5,8-dimethoxy-1,4-naphthoquinone
observations: Also designated R6; reported to suppress LPS-induced inflammatory responses and MAPK/NF-κB pathway activation in BV2 microglia.

entities.name: R6 suppresses BV2 activation
observations: In LPS-stimulated BV2 microglia, R6 reduced NO, ROS, pro-inflammatory cytokine expression, ERK/JNK/p38 phosphorylation, and IκB-α degradation; retrieved evidence did not establish direct NF-κB nuclear-translocation measurement.

entities.name: PMID:27512726
observations: Heliyon (2016) study of 2-cyclohexylamino-5,8-dimethoxy-1,4-naphthoquinone in LPS-stimulated BV2 microglial cells.
